title: クレーンゲーム大成功！

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Massive haul" recorded. An amazing result. Thank you very much, Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It is not a problem. I can keep the extra dolls as decorations in my room.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: When I look at these dolls, I detect a warm feeling deep inside my chest.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: In short, one might say they have a stabilizing effect on my mental well-being.
